problem: Train an action-conditioned world simulator that distinguishes near-success failures, rather than hallucinating completion after small action errors.
contribution: World-VLA-Loop introduces SANS success/near-success data and jointly predicts video plus reward from Cosmos latents; actual policy feedback refines the model before another RL phase. Shared latent reward is an efficiency design, not independent verification.
algorithm: Pretrain CosmosPredict2 on action-embedded SANS data; add MLP reward head to denoised DiT latents and optimize flow plus noise-weighted rewardMSE. Target finetune on success/failure episodes, then run modifiedOpenVLA-OFT GRPO in generated frames with thresholded rewards. Deploy policy to collect new failures/successes and restart world-model adaptation; reported next RL stages begin from baseSFT policy.
observations: Initial camera frames, absolute6DoFEEF poses plus binary gripper action, future videos and stepwise success labels. Target Franka uses fixed third-personD435; action chunk24. Uncalibrated binary gripper state is not SO101 aperture mapping or evidence of retained object.
actions: Seven-dimensional EEF/gripper action conditions mapped into DiT timestep embeddings; policy chunks24. No cross-embodiment low-level alignment is shown.
embodiment_and_data: ManiSkill pretraining35kvideo-action pairs across23tasks; target~50success+50failure trajectories/task. Physical Franka pick/place-cup and push-cube; target policy uses~50successful episodes, with additional near-failure data for model. Reward/outcome tests50samples/task; physical policy test30rollouts/task.
experiments: Video metrics, visual-success alignment, internal reward alignment and GRPO improvement versus SFT; oracleRL in LIBERO. Excludes long-horizonLIBERO100 due>300-frame drift. Figure4 real-task training curves are evaluated inside the learned world model, while Table3 is actual physical evaluation; must label them distinctly.
baselines: SFT policy, LIBERO ground-truth oracle, model without near-success data/reward head, Qwen3VL8B visual judge. Internal-head comparison uses same generated frames and is not an independent physical ground-truth reward.
quantitative_result: Table2 PDFp7 cup/push visual alignment90/84%, reward94/78%,50samples/task. Table3p8 actualcup13.3→36.7%,push26.7→40.0% after firstRL,30physicalrollouts; next iterationp8 reaches50.0/53.3%. Figure4 model-estimated curves must not be quoted as these physical rates. Table4p8 no-near-success real visual alignment54% versus90%full.
limitations: Integrated reward/model can share errors; first iteration visibly reward-hacks an unstable pushing behavior(p9). Near-failure coverage and new physical feedback remain needed. Long autoregressive tasks unsupported; small physical2task study and threshold0.9 do not prove general reliability. Iterative dataset naming includesSUPA/SANS inconsistency in prose.
code_and_license: Primary project https://showlab.github.io/World-VLA-Loop/ . Independent code/model/data license audit not performed. Cosmos and source datasets have separate terms; no code inspected/executed.
hardware_adaptation: ADAPT explicit near-success labels and separate actual versus model-estimated curves. Add outcome-alignment reports only from paired real observations; do not treat shared model reward as handover-hold evidence. New target embodiment needs calibration/action schema and target data, without controller edits.
